steps.en: Install it into a Linux + PyTorch environment
steps.zh: 在 Linux + PyTorch 环境里装上它

steps.en: Wrap loop components in a Booster with your chosen plugin
steps.zh: 用 Booster 和你选的 plugin 包住训练组件

steps.en: Injects the sharding — ZeRO, hybrid TP×PP, or Gemini offload — into those objects in place
steps.zh: 原地注入所选切分：ZeRO、混合并行或 Gemini offload

steps.en: Launch one process per GPU (or per node via a hostfile)
steps.zh: 每张卡起一个进程（多机用 hostfile）

steps.en: The normal loop now trains shards: gradients and optimizer state split across ranks
steps.zh: 普通循环从此在分片上训练：梯度与优化器状态切到各 rank

value.en: Models too large for one GPU train from your unchanged PyTorch loop, split across the cluster you already have
value.zh: 单卡装不下的大模型，用你没改写的 PyTorch 循环，在现成的集群上切开训练
